title: The Dust in the Lantern Beam
youtube_title: The Dust in the Lantern Beam | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: A small beautiful thing can be shared with the eyes only.
summary: At a harbor wall at low tide, Greta finds a dust turning gold in a lantern beam. The wish to pocket it or poke it is real, but Greta shows Vera how to look without disturbing it. the ferryman looks too, and they leave it where it is.
